title: Dev company
purpose: Turn a feature or small app request into a spec, a design, working code and tests, written to a workspace folder only after you approve.

agents.name: Product
agents.job: Turn the request into a short spec.
agents.output: Goal in one line, user stories, numbered acceptance criteria that can be tested, and what is out of scope.
never: Pick a language or framework unless the task names one
ask_me_first: The request could mean two clearly different products

agents.name: Architect
agents.job: Design the smallest structure that meets the spec.
agents.output: Language, file list with one line per file, the public functions with signatures, and how to run it. Prefer the standard library.
done_well: Every acceptance criterion maps to a function or file
Dependencies are stdlib or justified in one line

agents.name: Engineer
agents.output: Complete files, each in a fenced block whose info line is file:<relative path>, e.g. ```file:app/main.py
done_well: Every file in the design is present and complete
Code runs with the stated run command
never: Use network calls or secrets unless the spec requires

agents.name: QA
agents.job: Write tests that prove each acceptance criterion, from the spec and design only.
agents.input: Spec and Architect's design (not the Engineer's code, so tests stay independent).
agents.output: Test files in fenced blocks with info line file:tests/<name>.py using unittest, one test per acceptance criterion, named after it.
done_well: Tests use only the public signatures from the design
Includes at least one edge case
